scripts.test: npm run -w packages/core test && npm run -w packages/vscode test
scripts.typecheck: npm run -w packages/core typecheck && npm run -w packages/vscode typecheck
scripts.build: npm run -w packages/core build && npm run -w packages/vscode build
scripts.docs: concurrently -n core,docs -c cyan,magenta --kill-others "npm run -w packages/core watch" "npm run -w packages/docs dev"
scripts.icons:update: npm i -D simple-icons@latest -w packages/core && npm run build && npm run vscode:package
